name: Meadowgate Family Practice
description: General practice with 14,000 patients in the fictional town of Meadowgate.

items.title: Opening hours
items.content: The practice opens 08:05 to 18:35; extended hours on Tuesdays until 19:50. Notice MGP-HRS-1.

items.title: Flu clinic
items.content: Flu clinics run on 2026-11-07 and 2026-11-21 for patients over 65. Poster MGP-FLU-65.

items.title: Duty doctor rota
items.content: The duty doctor covers urgent calls from 08:00; this month it is Dr. Seren Hughes on Mondays. Rota MGP-DTY-11.

items.title: Repeat prescription rules
items.content: Repeat requests are processed within 2 working days; reviews are due every 13 months. Rules MGP-RPT-13.

items.title: Car park barrier contract
items.content: The car park barrier is serviced by Gatewise Systems twice a year at $310 per visit. Contract MGP-CPK-310.

items.title: Missed cancer diagnosis review
items.content: A review found that a patient with record 61-90452 had 3 appointments over 7 months before a bowel cancer referral; the family has been offered a meeting on 2026-11-25. Review MGP-SEA-1125-B.
